This can lead to significant tax savings over time, especially when the investor is in a higher tax bracket.

Secondly, Roth IRA contributions are not subject to income limits, making it accessible to a wider range of individuals. This flexibility allows people to save for retirement regardless of their income level.

This can result in a larger retirement income, as the investor will not have to pay taxes on the growth of their investments.

In summary, Roth IRA offers tax-free contributions, income flexibility, and tax-free growth, making it an attractive option for individuals looking to save for retirement.
